name: Camp Cobbossee
description_short: Overnight sports and adventure camp for boys in Monmouth, Maine, running since 1902. Campers stay for sessions of about three and a half weeks, and first-time campers in younger grades can choose a two-week option.

warnings: Boys only. A sister camp, Camp Kippewa for Girls, is linked.
The two-week 'Stay and Play' option is only for first-time campers leaving grades 2, 3 or 4, and spots are 'very limited'.
Enrollment is open for returning families. New families can enroll only if there is space in new-camper bunks.
The page lists parents' visiting day on the same date each session ends (July 15 and August 10). Ask the camp to confirm the exact pickup and end dates.
unknowns: Camper age range and full grade range (only the two-week option's grades are stated)
